sulfuricresonance.ponder.living_ember_la: Linking and Reading the Living Ember Lamp
The Living Ember Lamp remotely displays the heat and fuel condition of one Molten Rotor Furnace
Before placing it, right-click the furnace while holding the Lamp
The selected coordinates and dimension are stored on the item and shown in its tooltip
Once placed, the Lamp watches only the furnace selected by that stored link
A cold or inactive furnace leaves the Lamp dark at level 0
Fading or Smouldering heat raises it smoothly to level 7
Kindled or Seething heat raises it smoothly to level 11
At Radiant heat, the Lamp reaches its steady level 13 glow
With 200 fuel ticks or less remaining, a hot Lamp warns you by pulsing noticeably between levels 9 and 15
If the linked furnace is removed, unloaded, or in another dimension, the Lamp safely fades back to darkness
Link the Lamp item again before placing it beside a different furnace

sulfuricresonance.ponder.perforated_spri: Perforated Spritzer
Using the Perforated Spritzer
The Perforated Spritzer can store and disperse fluids in a downward fashion
It will hold up to 3500mB of any fluid
It cannot spray fluid on its own
It requires pressure from a pump once its tank is full
When the pump pushes fluid into a full Spritzer...
...it sprays the fluid downward!
The Spritzer can hydrate farmland
...it can also water crops!
Making their growth speed increase slightly only when farmland beneath them is fully hydrated
Mob Automation with the Perforated Spritzer
This setup uses a Perforated Spritzer to damage mobs and collect their drops
Sulfuric Acid applies Acid Burn and repeatedly damages living entities beneath the Spritzer
When the mob is defeated, its drops remain beneath the Spritzer
An Encased Fan pushes those dropped items toward the Funnel
The Funnel inserts the loot into the attached Chest automatically
Supplying Lava instead ignites entities caught beneath the Spritzer
Water has the opposite use, extinguishing burning entities below
Choose the supplied fluid to damage mobs, ignite them, or extinguish fire

sulfuricresonance.ponder.molten_rotor.op: The Molten Rotor Furnace converts stored heat into rotational force
Shafts can connect to either side of the furnace
At ambient temperature, the furnace remains idle until it reaches 300°C
Smouldering begins at 300°C and produces 32 RPM
Kindled begins at 500°C, raising output to 64 RPM
Seething begins at 800°C, producing 128 RPM and meeting the Superheated requirement
Radiant begins at 1300°C, producing 256 RPM and enabling Combustion recipes
The front gauge tracks chamber temperature as the furnace crosses each heat tier
Engineer's Goggles show temperature, heat state, stress capacity, generated speed, fuel and cooldown time
When fuel runs out, stored heat drains away and output slows through lower tiers before stopping
sulfuricresonance.ponder.sulfur.compatib: Sulfuric Resonance accepts processed sulfur through common item tags
Compatible sulfur items use c:sulfur; compatible sulfur dusts use c:dusts/sulfur
Properly tagged processed sulfur from other mods can replace Sulfuric Resonance Sulfur
Raw ores, chunks, and storage blocks are not processed sulfur inputs
Materials using private or missing tags may require dedicated compatibility
